name: Pseudodiastrophic Dysplasia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Pseudodiastrophic Dysplasia

criteria.description: Severe short-limbed dwarfism with rhizomelic shortening
Multiple joint contractures including clubfeet and camptodactyly
Characteristic radiographic findings including platyspondyly, metaphyseal irregularities, and epiphyseal abnormalities
Mild facial dysmorphic features such as micrognathia and midface hypoplasia
Identification of pathogenic variants in the SLC26A2 gene

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria (severe rhizomelic short stature, multiple joint contractures, and characteristic radiological features) with or without genetic confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for SLC26A2 mutations can confirm diagnosis but is not mandatory if clinical and radiological criteria are met.

laboratory: Genetic testing revealing mutations in SLC26A2 gene
imaging: Narrow thoracic cage on chest X-ray
genetic: Autosomal recessive mutations in SLC26A2 gene
other: Prenatal ultrasound may show limb shortening and joint contractures

distinguishingFeatures: More severe and lethal skeletal dysplasia

redFlags: Severe respiratory distress due to restrictive thoracic cage
Progressive neurological deficits from spinal cord compression
Failure to thrive with feeding difficulties
references: Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Pseudodiastrophic dysplasia: a distinct chondrodysplasia with multiple joint contractures. Am J Med Genet. 2007.
Orphanet: Pseudodiastrophic dysplasia. Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases. 2021.
